title: AI-Driven Review Systems: Evaluating LLMs in Scalable and Bias-Aware Academic Reviews

bias_targets.methodology: Creating augmented datasets by switching the order of the response columns in the prompt to mitigate bias related to the sequence in which responses are presented during inference.
Modifying the predicted probabilities post-processing by applying penalties based on the length of the responses to counteract the model's preference for longer text.
Using a fine-tuned DistilBERT model to penalize responses with negative sentiment or refusal patterns (e.g., 'I am sorry', 'I cannot provide') during post-processing.
Training the adjudicator model on a curated dataset and incorporating alignment techniques to prevent it from unfairly favoring its own outputs, similar LLMs, or self-promoting responses.
